extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent discussed Medicare Advantage plans with the customer, who prioritized keeping their doctors. The agent scheduled a follow-up call for 2 hours later to review specific plans.
composition.coaching_note: The agent asked the customer about their priorities, but then immediately started discussing specific plans without fully addressing the customer's concerns. To improve, the agent could ask more open-ended questions to understand the customer's needs and preferences.
